scope: Finite one-way collisionless continuation of the prospectively selected origin sheet; no global coupling or reconnection-rate claim
source_selection: First FLASH stored output t>=0.8; eta=.001, alpha=20, final 512x512, reflecting [-.5,.5]^2; fresh evidence source after method approval

physical_mapping.electric: ideal -u cross B; collisionless continuation drops FLASH resistivity

width_definition: max |Bx(0,z)| in 0<=z<=.1 divided by |dBx(0,z)/dz at z=0| using cubic spline of original source fields

observable.average: equal-area mean of local A then physical-time trapezoid with interpolated endpoints; never tensor-average before A
observable.missing_bins: Entire result ineligible; no dropping or zero filling

controls.mesh: Double cells with unchanged ppc, physical mapping, source, ROI and window; CFL fixed, so dt halves. Separate dt-only control resolves attribution.
controls.timestep: CFL .35 vs .7 at same mesh and ppc
controls.particles: ppc64 vs32 same mesh, CFL and duration
controls.seeds: fresh prospective seeds 6101 and 6102 after approval
controls.boundary: Same source, ROI, cell scale, ppc and timestep; half-size .3 vs .4; track particle origins separately
controls.bins: Use secondary bin tensors to reconstruct primary and bound shear; compare finer-bin A with counts explicit

uncertainty_rule: For each species start from maximum fresh-seed mean A. Add conservative observed absolute changes for source, boundary, mesh, timestep, ppc and full seed range; add maximum fourth-moment two-sigma sampling estimate (no temporal independence assumption), maximum between-subbin-flow pressure fraction, maximum primary-vs-secondary window-mean difference and maximum measured relativistic trace correction. Treat this as a declared conservative diagnostic envelope, not a calibrated statistical CI.

decision.supported: All qualification gates pass and each species mean plus envelope <=.20
decision.falsified: All qualification gates pass and at least one species mean minus envelope >.20

conditioning: Quiet exactly isotropic per-cell velocity covariance is a finite realization choice. Thermal and bulk flow are separated locally. Boundary influence must pass matched larger-patch evolution; light travel alone is insufficient. Debye scale is initially underresolved and requires measured mesh/heating qualification. All exploratory values remain exploratory.
